name: UpperTheory.V.PropA.frob
source: ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Type) [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℤ_[l] X] (g : Module.End ℤ_[l] X) (k : ℕ),
InPow 1 ((g - 1) ^ l ^ k) ↔ InPow 1 (g ^ l ^ k - 1) := by
((Polynomial.X - 1) ^ l ^ k - (Polynomial.X ^ l ^ k - 1) : Polynomial ℤ) := by
((Polynomial.X - 1) ^ l ^ k - (Polynomial.X ^ l ^ k - 1) : Polynomial ℤ) = 0 := by
have hc := congrArg (fun P => Polynomial.coeff P i) hmap
have key : (g - 1) ^ l ^ k - (g ^ l ^ k - 1) = (l : Module.End ℤ_[l] X) * Polynomial.aeval g Q := by
have step : ∀ f f' : Module.End ℤ_[l] X, (∃ h : Module.End ℤ_[l] X, f - f' = (l : Module.End ℤ_[l] X) * h) →
rintro f f' ⟨h, hh⟩ H x
have hf : f = (l : Module.End ℤ_[l] X) * h + f' := eq_add_of_sub_eq hh
rw [hf, LinearMap.add_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.natCast_apply, hy, smul_add,
· exact step _ _ ⟨-Polynomial.aeval g Q, by rw [mul_neg, ← key, neg_sub]⟩
show: For an endomorphism g of a module over the ℓ-adic integers and a natural k, the image of (g−1) raised to the power ℓᵏ lies in ℓX exactly when the image of g raised to ℓᵏ minus the identity lies in ℓX.
strategy: Work first in the integer polynomial ring. Reduction modulo ℓ makes the two polynomials equal by Frobenius, so their difference is divisible by ℓ. Evaluate at g.

steps.claim: Put $q=\ell^k$. The integer polynomial $P(t)=(t-1)^q-(t^q-1)$ is divisible by the constant polynomial $\ell$, because its reduction in $\mathbf F_\ell[t]$ vanishes.
steps.snippet:
have hpoly : (Polynomial.C (l : ℤ)) ∣
      ((Polynomial.X - 1) ^ l ^ k - (Polynomial.X ^ l ^ k - 1) : Polynomial ℤ) := by
steps.typedFact:
(Polynomial.C (l : ℤ)) ∣
      ((Polynomial.X - 1) ^ l ^ k - (Polynomial.X ^ l ^ k - 1) : Polynomial ℤ)

children.claim: Divisibility of $P$ by the constant $\ell$ is equivalent to divisibility of each integer coefficient of $P$ by $\ell$.
Over $\mathbf F_\ell$ the $k$-fold Frobenius identity gives $(t-1)^{\ell^k}=t^{\ell^k}-1$, so the reduction of $P$ is zero.
children.snippet:
have hmap : Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod l))
        ((Polynomial.X - 1) ^ l ^ k - (Polynomial.X ^ l ^ k - 1) : Polynomial ℤ) = 0 := by
      simp only [Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_pow, Polynomial.map_X, Polynomial.map_one]
      rw [sub_pow_char_pow, one_pow, sub_self]
children.typedFact:
Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom (ZMod l))
        ((Polynomial.X - 1) ^ l ^ k - (Polynomial.X ^ l ^ k - 1) : Polynomial ℤ) = 0

children.claim: The $i$-th coefficient of the reduced polynomial is the residue of $[t^i]P$ and is zero. Thus $\ell$ divides $[t^i]P$ for every $i$.
children.snippet:
have hc := congrArg (fun P => Polynomial.coeff P i) hmap
    simp only [Polynomial.coeff_map, Polynomial.coeff_zero] at hc
    exact (ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd _ l).1 hc

steps.claim: Choose $Q\in\mathbf Z[t]$ with $P=\ell Q$, as supplied by polynomial divisibility.
Write $A=(g-1)^q$ and $B=g^q-1$. Evaluation at $g$ sends $P=\ell Q$ to $A-B=\ell Q(g)$ in the endomorphism ring.
steps.snippet:
have key : (g - 1) ^ l ^ k - (g ^ l ^ k - 1) = (l : Module.End ℤ_[l] X) * Polynomial.aeval g Q := by
    have := congrArg (Polynomial.aeval g) hQ
    simpa using this
steps.typedFact: (g - 1) ^ l ^ k - (g ^ l ^ k - 1) = (l : Module.End ℤ_[l] X) * Polynomial.aeval g Q

steps.claim: For endomorphisms $f,f'$ with $f-f'=\ell h$, the inclusion $f'(X)\subseteq\ell X$ implies $f(X)\subseteq\ell X$ by adding the two $\ell$-multiples pointwise.
steps.snippet:
have step : ∀ f f' : Module.End ℤ_[l] X, (∃ h : Module.End ℤ_[l] X, f - f' = (l : Module.End ℤ_[l] X) * h) →
      InPow 1 f' → InPow 1 f := by
steps.typedFact:
∀ f f' : Module.End ℤ_[l] X, (∃ h : Module.End ℤ_[l] X, f - f' = (l : Module.End ℤ_[l] X) * h) →
      InPow 1 f' → InPow 1 f

children.claim: For $x\in X$, choose $y$ with $f'(x)=\ell y$. The equation $f-f'=\ell h$ makes $y+h(x)$ a candidate preimage of $f(x)$ under multiplication by $\ell$.
children.snippet:
rintro f f' ⟨h, hh⟩ H x
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := H x
    refine ⟨y + h x, ?_⟩
have hf : f = (l : Module.End ℤ_[l] X) * h + f' := eq_add_of_sub_eq hh
children.typedFact: f = (l : Module.End ℤ_[l] X) * h + f'

children.claim: The pointwise equality $f(x)=\ell h(x)+f'(x)=\ell h(x)+\ell y=\ell(y+h(x))$ verifies the required image containment.
children.snippet:
rw [pow_one] at hy ⊢
    rw [hf, LinearMap.add_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.natCast_apply, hy, smul_add,
      Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℤ_[l] l (h x), add_comm]

steps.claim: The relation $A-B=\ell Q(g)$ can be read in either direction, so image containment in $\ell X$ transfers both ways.

children.claim: When $A(X)\subseteq\ell X$, the equality $B-A=\ell(-Q(g))$ transfers this containment to $B(X)$ by the pointwise argument.
children.snippet: · exact step _ _ ⟨-Polynomial.aeval g Q, by rw [mul_neg, ← key, neg_sub]⟩

children.claim: If $B(X)\subseteq\ell X$, the equality $A-B=\ell Q(g)$ yields $A(X)\subseteq\ell X$.

chapterTitle: Twisted cokernels in a cyclotomic tower
